back: Control livestock, paddocks for rotational grazing, separate stock, disease control, protect crops, boundaries, security, shelter.
Barbed wire: cattle. Mesh/netting: goats, sheep, poultry. Electric: rotational grazing. Hedges and windbreaks: boundaries and shelter.
Energiser sends pulses along insulated wire; an animal touching it completes the circuit through the ground to earth rods.
Light stay fixed to the wires between posts to keep them spaced; does not reach the ground.
Wire strainer, fencing pliers, wire cutters, post-hole digger, crowbar, sledgehammer, tape and pegs, gloves.
Debark and season; then pressure treatment, hot-and-cold tank, butt soaking, brushing or charring.
Water-borne (e.g. copper chrome arsenate, pressure-applied) and oil-type (e.g. creosote).
Galvanising (zinc), rust-inhibiting paint, tar or bitumen on the buried part.
Steel: long life, fire- and termite-proof, costly. Wood: cheap, local, needs treatment, burns.
